portfolio_role: High-conviction catalyst short in a payments value-trap and turnaround-failure setup.
intended_role_notes: New short intended to express the view that PYPL's apparent Q2 turnaround was low quality and vulnerable to a Q3/2026 guidance reset.
recommended_expression: November 2025 PYPL put spread, such as a 67.50/60.00 bear put spread, to define earnings-event risk.
target_size: Start with about 150 bps of portfolio NAV at risk through a defined-risk put spread; max about 250 bps of premium at risk if the pre-earnings setup and option pricing are favorable.
liquidity_notes: The common equity was liquid and borrow was described as available at low cost, but a direct common short would fight buybacks and binary earnings gap risk. Defined-risk options are preferred unless borrow, liquidity, and stop discipline are explicitly selected.
risk_budget_notes: Size against fintech factor exposure, consumer-spending exposure, interest-rate sensitivity through customer-balance yield, Nasdaq/growth beta, and the possibility of a broad tech rally or earnings squeeze.
human_notes: Sizing and expression are taken from the user-provided PYPL research case but normalized as premium-at-risk because the preferred expression is an option spread rather than a direct common-stock short.
